url.description: Original input URL or bare domain requested for auditing.

normalizedInputUrl.description: Normalized HTTP/HTTPS URL derived from input.

finalUrl.description: Resolved homepage URL after validated HTTP redirects.

status.description: Audit execution status (audited, blocked_ssrf, blocked_robots, error).

pageTitle.description: HTML document <title> of the store homepage.

detectedLanguage.description: Detected store language code (e.g. de, en, fr, es, it, nl, pl).

ecommercePlatform.description: Detected e-commerce platform (shopify, woocommerce, shopware, prestashop, magento, bigcommerce, wix, squarespace, custom).

loadTimeMs.description: Total store audit duration in milliseconds.

pagesFetchedCount.description: Total HTTP pages fetched for this store (homepage + internal legal/subpages).

pagesFetched.description: URLs of all pages inspected on this store.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error or security block reason when status is not audited.

complianceScore.description: Deterministic 0-100 EU e-commerce technical compliance score (100 = no heuristic issues detected).

riskTier.description: Heuristic compliance risk tier: CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, or LOW.

withdrawalStatus.description: EU Art. 11a electronic withdrawal classification (compliant_2step, partial_single_step, login_walled, static_policy_or_pdf_only, missing, not_checked).

withdrawalButtonFound.description: Whether an interactive electronic withdrawal button/link was detected.

withdrawalTwoStepCompliant.description: Whether a guest-accessible 2-step interactive withdrawal + confirmation flow was detected.

withdrawalLoginWallDetected.description: Whether the withdrawal link redirects to or requires account login (/account/login, /wp-login.php, etc.).

withdrawalButtonCheck.description: Detailed Directive (EU) 2023/2673 Art. 11a / BGB § 356a withdrawal button analysis.

abolishedOdrLinkFound.description: Whether an outdated link to the abolished EU ODR platform (ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr) was detected.

odrLinkCheck.description: Detailed Regulation (EU) 2024/3228 abolished EU ODR link check.

unsubstantiatedGreenClaimsFound.description: Whether generic environmental claims were detected without recognized third-party certification signals.

empCoGreenClaimsCheck.description: Detailed Directive (EU) 2024/825 EmpCo environmental claims & certification evidence check.

omnibusViolationFound.description: Whether discount/strike-through pricing was detected without 30-day lowest prior price wording.

omnibusPricingCheck.description: Detailed Directive (EU) 2019/2161 Art. 6a Omnibus 30-day reference price check.

legalLinks.description: Structured legal page URLs discovered on the store.

findingsCount.description: Total number of compliance findings flagged.

findings.description: Prioritized technical compliance findings with ruleId, regulation, severity, evidence, and recommendation.

coldOutreachHook.description: Neutral, factual 1-2 sentence B2B outreach observation ready for Clay, n8n, Smartlead, or Instantly.

remediationPackGenerated.description: Whether a multilingual Art. 11a HTML/JS widget + Omnibus remediation pack was generated.

remediationPack.description: Copy-pasteable multilingual 2-step Art. 11a Electronic Withdrawal Widget (HTML/JS) + Omnibus 30-day snippet.

recommendedNextActors.description: Recommended follow-up Apify Actors (e.g. WCAG 2.2 / EAA & Overlay Visual Screenshot Auditor).

overview.title: EU Store Compliance & Lead Enrichment Overview
